Committee: Governmental Affairs
Sponsor: Hatcher
Analyst: JT Mathis
Date: 03/14/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 304 as introduced would add two members to the Alabama Plumbers and Gas Fitters Examining Board which would increase the obligations of the Board by an estimated $720 per meeting.
Further, this bill could increase the obligations of the Board by an undetermined amount to allow the Board to adopt rules regarding continuing education requirements. These obligations could be offset, wholly or in part, by fees levied and collected for continuing education, as provided by this bill.
Finally, this bill requires a certificate holder, subject to disciplinary action, to satisfy all fines, fees, and restitution prior to recertification, which could increase receipts to the Board by an undetermined amount dependent on the amount of any such fine or fees that otherwise would not have been paid.
Jimmy Holley, Chairperson
Governmental Affairs
